standard-dialogue.npc: Hello, and welcome to the Crafting Guild. Accomplished crafters from all over the land come here to use our top notch workshops.

standard-dialogue.prompt: Would you like to ask about a Skillcape of Crafting?

steps.player: Hey, what is that cape you're wearing? I don't recognise it.

steps.npc: This? This is a Skillcape of Crafting. It is a symbol of my ability as master of the Crafting Guild and it provides unlimited teleports here.
If you should ever achieve level 99 Crafting come and talk to me and we'll see if we can sort you out with one.

if-the-player-has-99-crafting.npc: Hello, and welcome to the Crafting Guild. Accomplished crafters from all over the land come here to use our top notch workshops.

steps.player: Are you the person I need to talk to about buying a Skillcape of Crafting?

steps.npc: I certainly am, and I can see that you are definitely talented enough to own one! The cape has a built-in teleport back to us at the guild too!
Unfortunately, being such a prestigious item, they are appropriately expensive. I'm afraid I must ask you for 99000 gold.
Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have 99,000 coins:

steps.player: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.

steps.npc: Well, come back and see me when you do.

steps.text: If the player has at least 99,000 coins but not enough inventory space:

steps.npc: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.

steps.text: If the player has at least 99,000 coins and enough inventory space:

steps.npc: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.

steps.player: May I have another hood for my cape, please?

steps.npc: Most certainly, and free of charge!

when-trying-to-enter-the-guild-without-w.npc: Where's your brown apron? You can't come in here unless you're wearing one.

when-trying-to-enter-the-guild-whilst-we.npc: Welcome to the Guild of Master Craftsmen.

young-capeless-master-crafter.player: So... are you here to give crafting tips?

young-capeless-master-crafter.npc: Dude, do I look like I wanna talk to you?

capeless-master-crafter.npc: Hello, and welcome to the Crafting Guild. Accomplished crafters from all over the land come here to use our top notch workshops.
